facts.fact: Menos Fios reports, from a report by the interbank services company EMIS, that its Cidadao Digital project, run with public-private partnerships, has reached over 600,000 Angolans since 2022 with free digital literacy training in several provinces at community centres and schools, including rural areas.

systems.owner: EMIS (Empresa Interbancaria de Servicos) with public-private partners
